propositions: BindingRepository must deserialize legacy and unknown-field fixtures to byte-identical sorted/indented JSON with trailing newlines and perform no eager writes on construction.
Unconditional save must attempt rotation sidecar persistence before live file replacement, retaining inline last_get_pass in live when sidecar write fails, without raising an exception.
Corrupt live state must raise ValueError and preserve the file; corrupt retired state must fail open with best-effort alerting and preserve the file.
After rotation write failure leaves live with inline floor, a subsequent save must write the retained floor to the sidecar before live replacement, achieving convergence.
Live or retired file persistence failure must preserve earlier successful writes, clean temp files, and raise; alert persistence failure must be swallowed without altering the state-file result.
